summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a side letter extending key deadlines under its existing Investment and Share Purchase Agreement with seller Matani Moskovich and C.M. Composite Materials. The Belrise Condition long-stop date and Outside Closing Date were both extended retroactively from March 31 and June 30, 2026, respectively, to December 31, 2026. The company retains termination rights without liability if the Belrise Condition is not satisfied or waived by the new date, subject to no material breach. This effectively prolongs the deal timeline, with the closing contingent on the Belrise Condition. What to watch: whether the condition is satisfied or the agreement terminates by year-end.
